name: USSF-627
destination_explanation: Being close to the ground is the point: signals arrive quickly and cameras see fine detail, which is why internet and imaging satellites settle here.
slot_a_text: A classified mission for the United States Space Force. It is possibly a batch of classified LEO satellites based on SpaceX’s Starshield satellite bus, based on locations of rocket stage drop zones being exact fits with previous Starlink Group 15 launches.
slot_b_text: Falcon 9 uses friction stir welding to fuse its aluminum-lithium tanks without melting the metal.
